entries.title: Roulette main payout / ticket printer payout method
entries.answer: Ticket payout needs TWO layers: (1) ruleta setup.xml pay system outputtype + userpayout type, AND (2) HW driverssetup alias tito @ tcp://127.0.0.1:30400 with CommCtrl listening on :30400. Setup alone is not enough.
entries.setting: pay system → outputtype  and  pay system → userpayout → type  (software); plus HW driverssetup → aliasName tito → endpointaddress tcp://127.0.0.1:30400
notes: On disk this setup.xml is gcxml-encrypted; Helper decrypts in memory for search/excerpts (do not hand-edit the ciphertext).
BiOS / Setup2: Game settings → Pay system (output type / user payout type). Prefer the UI — values are numeric enums.

Also required: HW driver alias tito in config\etc\application\HW\driverssetup\configuration.xml (tcp://127.0.0.1:30400). Without it, runtime falls back to handpay even when outputtype/userpayout type already say ticket.
If HWSetup shows :30400 grey and only switch (:30600) + lights (:30700) active, tito is missing from driverssetup — restore tito before Save in HWSetup (Save can drop disconnected endpoints).
Ignore xml-configs\…\setup.xml (schema/mirror) and serialport\layout.json (COM name map only).

entries.title: Slot cashout button mode (Cashless vs Handpay)
entries.answer: Slot cashout button mode lives in mgconfig.xml (not roulette pay system).
notes: This controls the multigamer cashout button behavior, not roulette ticket/hopper payout type.

entries.title: Ticket printer hardware driver (tito)
entries.answer: Ticket printer channel is the HW driverssetup tito entry (not serialport layout).
notes: COM map for Ticket printer(s) is serialport\layout.json / locations.json — do not hand-edit those for payout config.
Bill acceptor is KeyCtrl COM3→30300, not driverssetup.

entries.title: Serialport layout is COM map only
entries.answer: serialport layout.json is the board COM name map — not the payout method setting.
notes: For payout method use ruleta setup.xml pay system outputtype / userpayout type.
Do not rewrite layout.json / locations.json casually — can drop Leds/COM7 and break lights.

entries.title: Multigamer inactivity / game selector
entries.answer: Multigamer inactivity timeout is in mgconfig.xml.

entries.title: SAS serial COM port
entries.answer: SAS serial COM is configured in CommCtrlSAS CommControler.ini.

entries.title: Roulette payout auto-confirm
entries.answer: payoutAutoConfirm is a node in encrypted ruleta setup.xml.
notes: Helper decrypts setup.xml in memory for search; on-disk file stays encrypted.
